text: Samruk-Kazyna, founded in 2008 by decree of the President of Kazakhstan, is the country's sovereign wealth fund; its sole shareholder is the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
short: Samruk-Kazyna is wholly owned by the Government of Kazakhstan.

source.name: Samruk-Kazyna JSC — About the Fund
source.quote: The sole shareholder of the Fund is the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan.

additionalSources.name: Kapital.kz — Раскрыты подробности сделки по вхождению Cамрук-Казыны в акционеры ERG
additionalSources.quote: Таким образом, сейчас 40% ERG принадлежат ФНБ «Самрук-Казына», единственным акционером которого является Правительство Республики Казахстан.
additionalSources.note: Translation: '40% of ERG now belongs to the Samruk-Kazyna NWF, whose sole shareholder is the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan.'
